text: I can explain why prefill is compute-bound and decode is memory-bandwidth-bound, and estimate both from parameter count and assumed hardware numbers.
I can compute KV cache bytes per token from a published model config and work out how many concurrent requests fit on a GPU.
I can contrast static batching, continuous batching and PagedAttention, and describe what happens when KV blocks run out.
I can define TTFT and TPOT, compute end-to-end latency from them, and say which one a given change affects.
I can compute a self-hosted cost per million tokens from GPU price, throughput and utilisation, and argue hosted versus self-hosted for a workload.
